Linux and Windows 10 are free for very different meanings of the word.

Windows 10 is free as in gratis. It simply means that you pay nothing to get it (*conditions may apply).

Linux (and much if not most of the software in a desktop installation thereof) is free as in libre. This has a much more complex and articulated meaning (the source is available, and it can be modified and redistributed in modified form with the only condition that this is done by preserving the license), which also implies that it can generally be obtained gratis or at very lo cost.

The “if a product is free, you're the product” only applies for the first meaning of the word.

"Free as in beer" => Windows 10

"Free as in freedom (isn't free)" => Linux

Powershell commands:

Get-Service DiagTrack | Set-Service -StartupType Disabled

Get-Service dmwappushservice | Set-Service -StartupType Disabled

reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection\ /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
